name: Sinking Anchor
text: After bidding, a chosen opponent's highest card loses 4 rank.
decision: None for the owner; shapes bidding confidence.
opponent: Visible after bids; it costs one opponent about half a trick.
aiNote: Choose the opponent who didn't bid nil and whose highest card is highest.
rationale: An ace becomes a 10 and a king becomes a 9, which costs one opponent about half a trick after they have bid. At 3 ranks an ace becomes a jack and still wins most tricks.
deviation: Revision 1: one chosen opponent instead of each opponent.
